name: Facet
author: Erin Carter
description: A cut-crystal jewel: the angle around centre is mirror-folded into N wedges and the folded space is partitioned into hard diamond facets — concentric facet rings of brick-offset wedgelets, each a flat crystal face catching a slowly-turning raking light, with sharp bright cut-lines glinting between them. Most faces sit deep in shadow while a few sparkle, so the gem twinkles as the light wanders, dark toward the corners.

params.label: Folds
params.effect: Number of mirror wedges in the kaleidoscope; low values give broad cathedral-like facets, high values a tight snowflake cut.

params.label: Sparkle rate
params.effect: Speed the raking light turns across the facets — how fast the crystal faces twinkle and trade their glints.

params.label: Facet size
params.effect: Characteristic facet size in CSS px; small cuts the gem into many fine facets, large into a few broad crystal faces.
